notes.content:

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Misc.
notes.content:
Bug Fixes & Misc.

 Fixed an issue which caused the boss battles to behave incorrectly.
 Moved various gutter locations on Rickety Rapids.

notes.title: Major Balance Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes

 All maps have had their time limits extended in both regular bowling & witch hunt modes.
 All maps have had their scores to beat lowered in regular bowling mode.
 The gem locations on Riveting Rooftops have been altered
 The starting section on Construction Chaos has been redesigned.
 The basketball model has been slightly improved.

notes.title: 2022-09-14 Stunning Streets Hotfix
notes.content:
Patch Notes

 Fixed numerous problem locations found within the map.

notes.title: Difficulty Adjustments & Ducks!
notes.content:
Difficulty Adjustments

 Most stages have been rebalanced and made easier.
 In most cases more time was added and the target score was also lowered.
 Some stages have had the amount of obstacles which spawn decreased.


Ducks

 Ducks were added to the pond in Mushroom Marsh, enjoy!

notes.title: 2022-08-30 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Magical Meadows

 Decreased the number of pendulums trees on the map at once.
 Lowered the target score.



Misc.

 Fixed an issue where the character would rotate at different speeds on different pcs in the customization menu.

notes.title: 2022-08-25 Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes

 Expanded the How To Play section.
 The How To Play section is now accessible from the in-game pause menu.
 Added a scrollbar to the How To Play section.

notes.title: Patch notes 2022-08-04
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

 Fixed a bug where the magical trail would sometimes activate even when it was turned off in the customization screen.
 Voodoo Village - Various changes to tornado strength/behavior.

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch #4:
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

 Construction Chaos - Crates are now easier to ride.
 Great Gamble - Decreased score to beat in story/arcade.
 Great Gamble - Removed one of the pins from Totem tracker, decreased time allowed to accommodate.

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch #3:
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

 Performance improvements on all maps.
 Construction Chaos - Decreased score to beat.
 Checkered Challenge - Decreased score to beat.
 Training Tracks - Increased score to beat.
 Music Madness - Increased score to beat.

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch #2:
notes.content:
Stunning Streets:

 Added Cardinals as scenery.
 Fixed some visual geometry issues on the sidewalk.
 Fixed an area where the ball could clip through the ground.
 The ball can no longer get stuck under parked cars.
 Changed colors of various cars.


Magical Meadows:

 Pendulums now sway less but at a faster rate.


Card Crazy:

 Added a new type of moving card obstacle.


Voodoo Village:

 Added Seagulls as scenery.


Doubloon Docks:

 Added Toucans as scenery.


Construction Chaos:

 Added Pigeons as scenery.

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch #1:
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

 Expanded the How to Play section on the Main Menu.
 Camera settings has been renamed to Gameplay Settings.
 Added the ability to lock the game to 60 FPS in the gameplay settings menu.
 Decreased the volume of the squawking parrot by approximately 30%.
 Added the ability to mute the squawking parrot in the audio settings.
 Fixed a bug related to the text box on the opening cutscene.
 Adjusted the pins on Rickety Rapids to make the level slightly easier.
